name: Llama 3.2 (3B)
macRamRequired: 8 GB System RAM (2.2 GB VRAM Footprint)
setupSteps: Download LM Studio from lmstudio.ai, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, Msty from msty.app, or Open WebUI from openwebui.com.
Search for "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct" in your chosen desktop app model catalog.
Click the 1-Click Download button (Q4_K_M version recommended).
Select the model in your chat header and start asking questions offline!
description: Meta's 3B instruction model. Small enough for 8 GB Macs and quick on short summaries and Q&A.

name: Qwen 2.5 (7B)
macRamRequired: 16 GB System RAM (4.7 GB VRAM Footprint)
setupSteps: Download Ollama from ollama.com, LM Studio from lmstudio.ai, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, Msty from msty.app, or Open WebUI from openwebui.com.
Search for "Qwen-2.5-7B" in the app discover tab.
Click Download to save model files directly to your Mac unified storage.
Launch local chat session with zero configuration needed.
description: Alibaba's 7B general model with strong multilingual coverage. A common default for writing and chat on 16 GB Macs.

name: DeepSeek-R1 (8B)
macRamRequired: 16 GB System RAM (4.9 GB VRAM Footprint)
setupSteps: Download Ollama from ollama.com, Jan from jan.ai, or GPT4All from gpt4all.io.
Open Terminal or app library and pull: ollama pull deepseek-r1:8b
Wait for initial model download to complete (approx 4.9 GB).
Chat in desktop apps like Jan (jan.ai), GPT4All (gpt4all.io), Msty (msty.app), or Open WebUI (openwebui.com).
description: An 8B distilled reasoning model that writes out its thinking before the answer. Slower per answer, useful for multi-step problems.

name: Whisper (Large-v3)
macRamRequired: 8 GB System RAM (3.1 GB VRAM Footprint)
setupSteps: Download MacWhisper from goodsnooze.gumroad.com/l/macwhisper or use Jan / Open WebUI extensions.
Choose "Whisper Large-v3 Turbo" in MacWhisper model preferences.
The app automatically configures Apple Metal GPU acceleration.
Drag any MP3, WAV, or MOV file into MacWhisper for local transcription.
description: OpenAI's speech-to-text model, run through whisper.cpp-based apps such as MacWhisper. Supports many languages.

name: Phi-3.5 Mini (3.8B)
macRamRequired: 8 GB System RAM (2.6 GB VRAM Footprint)
setupSteps: Download LM Studio from lmstudio.ai, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, or Msty from msty.app.
Search for "Phi-3.5-mini-instruct" in the model catalog.
Click Download (requires under 3 GB storage).
Select Phi-3.5 in the chat top bar for local dictation cleanup.
description: Microsoft's 3.8B model. Small footprint, suited to short rewriting and cleanup tasks.
